metadata.description: cGradying's Claude Code mods: the cockpit band and guards, and vendored community mods, patched to start quiet.

plugins.name: cockpit
plugins.description: Band above the prompt, guards, and a cheat sheet. Depends on the seven mods below, so installing it installs them all.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Step through the file edits Claude made in the last turn (Anthropic playground, Apache-2.0).

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Hold rm -rf, git reset --hard, force push and migrations until you press Proceed (Anthropic playground, Apache-2.0).

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Progress bar and agents panel for flows and subagents (JohnnyVizz, MIT).

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Cold-send price warning and opt-in keep-warm for the prompt cache (karanb192, MIT). Patched: warn, keep-warm off.

plugins.name: reflect-mod
plugins.description: Turns corrections into rules you can save to CLAUDE.md (BayramAnnakov, MIT). Patched: starts paused.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: IDE-style file tree in the sidebar with git status and activity (data-goblin, MIT).

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: Skins for the transcript, /skin to swap (hellosverre, MIT). Patched: starts off, own band off.
